title: SWE-WhatIf: Simulating Real Users of Coding Agents from Recorded Session
abstract: arXiv:2611.21095v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recorded sessions between users and coding agents offer a way to evaluate how agents complete real-world tasks and interact with users. However, these sessions cannot simply be replayed with new agents, because recorded user replies may no longer apply when an agent takes a different trajectory. We introduce SWE-WhatIf, which replays recorded sessions with new agents by modeling the user's intents, the criteria for satisfying them, and the conditions under which they arise. Using this model, a user simulator generates replies that adapt to unseen agent turns while remaining grounded in the recording. Across 89 real-world sessions, SWE-WhatIf generated the replies most similar to those of real users and matched the strongest baseline when sessions were rewritten. translated_title: SWE-WhatIf：从录制会话中模拟编码智能体的真实用户
translated_abstract: 用户与编码智能体之间的录制会话提供了一种评估智能体如何完成真实世界任务并与用户交互的方法。然而，这些会话无法简单地用新的智能体进行重放，因为当智能体采取不同的行动轨迹时，录制中的用户回复可能不再适用。我们提出了SWE-WhatIf，它通过建模用户的意图、满足这些意图的标准以及这些意图出现的条件，用新的智能体重放录制的会话。利用这一模型，用户模拟器能够生成适应未见过的智能体回合的回复，同时仍以原始录制内容为基础。在89个真实世界会话上，SWE-WhatIf生成的回复与真实用户的回复最为相似，并且在会话被重写时达到了与最强基线相当的表现。为了测试其适应能力，我们使用被指示避免或重复录制用户曾反对的行为的智能体来重放会话。SWE-WhatIf在避免（用户反对行为）方面取得了最高的胜率。
tldr: 该论文提出SWE-WhatIf，通过建模用户意图、满足标准及其触发条件来模拟编码智能体的真实用户，使模拟用户回复能适应新智能体的不同行为轨迹，从而实现录制会话在跨智能体场景下的重放评估。
en_tdlr: SWE-WhatIf simulates real users of coding agents from recorded sessions by modeling user intents, satisfaction criteria, and triggering conditions, enabling simulated replies that adapt to unseen agent behaviors for cross-agent session replay evaluation.
